finalText:
Saved to `INCIDENT_HANDOFF.md`.

Root cause: `dep-4471` flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true` without raising pool size, so the pool of 20 connections saturated. First 503 hit at 02:14:18Z, four minutes after the deploy started, and it was still ongoing at the end of the log with the wait queue up to 74.

Impact was gateway-only. Workers stayed clean through the same window. Roll back `dep-4471` to fix it.
